question: Are servants connected to both family lines included among those remembered?
premises: Servants in both family lines are mentioned.
Both deceased servants and non-deceased servants are mentioned.
They are included in the offering's scope.
inference: Servants of both family lines, whether dead or not, are included among those remembered.
uncertainties: amṛta+sevakāḥ may mean servants who are not dead or servants of the immortals; context suggests living/non-dead servants
plain_english: Those in both my family lines who became servants and have died, and likewise those servants who are not dead, are included.
